_comment: Repo-relative MCP servers for AppBI. Copy this to .mcp.json (which is
git-ignored because it also holds machine-specific servers such as Serena),
or merge the entries below into the .mcp.json you already have.
appbi-guardrail is the read-only engineering guardrail in
subsystems, impact scope, required tests, invariant checks on a diff. It
run-mcp.sh (or run-mcp.ps1) bootstraps a venv with them if your system
python lacks them — point 'command' at that script instead if so.
You do not need this server for the gates to work. The same rule base runs
deterministically via scripts/ci/guardrail_check.py, which is what the
hooks and CI use. This entry is for asking it questions in conversation.
